scene_summary: An expressionist painted plate on a cream ground, with a large rose-pink pointed-ear facial fragment at left and a smaller fragment at right. A cream-ringed charcoal eye sits beside a ragged descending charcoal-and-rose boundary on the larger face. Turquoise washes, orange-red mouth paint, dry-brushed dark streaks and thin drips interrupt the ground.
usable_surfaces: Ragged charcoal-and-rose pigment boundary immediately right of the large cream-haloed eye

detected_objects.label: Broad ragged rose-to-charcoal pigment boundary beside the large cream-haloed pupil
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Immediately to the right of the large cream-ringed black eye, rose paint meets an irregular charcoal stroke. The visible boundary descends from a narrow broken dark passage into a broad black knot with pink intrusions, coarse brush edges and a frayed lower fringe. The polygon follows this connected painted feature rather than enclosing the face or nearby cream ground.

complexity_assessment.rationale: Clearly expressionist, with two unequal facial fragments and a broad cream interval preserving hierarchy. Multiple colored washes, dark vertical streaks and drips make it more textured than strictly minimal, but not excessively cluttered. Only the single planned source-bearing boundary is mapped; the other facial marks remain unbound.
